title: Pure Melffy
summary: The pure Level 2 EARTH Beast Melffy build featuring the Chaos Origins support (Melffy Rabbys, Melffy Footsteps, Melffy Playtime Surprise, Melffys' Joyful Surprise, and Melffy Godmommy) alongside generic staples. Every Main Deck Melffy deploys itself during your End Phase and bounces back to your hand when the opponent summons or attacks to trigger searches, recruits, and opponent's-turn Xyz, Synchro, and Fusion plays.

summary.title: Starters
points: Melffy Footsteps adds up to 4 differently named Melffy monsters from your Deck to your hand, then immediately jumps to your End Phase so all of them can Special Summon themselves at once.
Melffy Wally bounces itself when the opponent summons or targets it for an attack to Special Summon two different Melffys (such as Melffy Puppy and Melffy Catty) from the Deck.

Melffy Rabbys Special Summons itself when the opponent summons and can immediately Fusion Summon; when summoned, it searches a Melffy monster and deploys Beasts if you searched the Normal Monster Melffy Rabby.

summary.title: Opening: Footsteps or Wally into End-Phase Swarm
steps: Activate Melffy Footsteps to search four different Melffys (such as Puppy, Catty, Wally, and Fenny), jumping straight to your End Phase where they all Special Summon themselves from your hand.

Alternatively, overlay two Level 2 Beasts into Melffy of the Forest to search Melffy Staring Contest or Melffy Playtime Surprise, and let your remaining Melffys summon themselves during the End Phase.

On the opponent's turn, as they Normal or Special Summon, bounce Wally to summon Puppy and Catty from the Deck, bounce Puppy to summon Kalantosa or Melffy Pinny, and bounce Catty to search Melffy Pinny or Melffy Rabbys.

summary.title: Opponent's-Turn Synchro & Fusion Plays
summary.text: Because the Melffy monsters return from the field to your hand during the opponent's turn, your hand fills with Beast monsters mid-chain. Melffy Pinny Special Summons itself from the hand as a Quick Effect on the turn a Beast returned to your hand and immediately Synchro Summons Merry Melffys using Melffys in your hand as material, while Melffy Rabbys and Melffy Playtime Surprise Fusion Summon Melffys' Joyful Surprise on the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Melffy Godmommy stacks directly onto Melffy Mommy, searches a Melffy Spell/Trap, and can detach 5 materials to return all cards the opponent controls to the hand.
Melffys' Joyful Surprise bounces opponent's cards up to the number of Melffys you control and revives a Beast when the opponent summons.
Merry Melffys bounces an opposing face-up monster on Synchro Summon and can return itself to the Extra Deck to summon a Beast Xyz like Joyous Melffys.
Melffy of the Forest searches a Melffy card and negates an opposing monster's effects when another Melffy returns to your hand.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Melffy Staring Contest reveals a Beast in your hand during your opponent's turn to swap it for a Melffy from the Deck, and drops opposing monsters' ATK by the combined ATK+DEF of Beasts revealed in your hand.
Melffy Hide-and-Seek protects your Beast monsters from being destroyed by card effects once per turn each and recycles 3 Beasts from the GY to draw 1 card.
Melffy Playhouse detaches any number of Xyz Materials from a Beast Xyz to bounce that many opponent's cards.
